scope: Fixed-seed two-base LRU opening-stock comparison. F03.var01's second-base crew, unit, mission, maintainer and depot link are applied to the accepted F02.var02 risk fleet. The two arms differ only in the BASE-01 TEACH-LRU-01 StockAllocation quantity 0 versus 1 and descriptive text.
expected_timeline: The accepted risk parent has a late BASE-01 LRU demand. The added BASE-02 mission may shift fixed-seed random timing; read fault and demand events from each fresh run and require a matched local demand before assigning causality.

If a matched BASE-01 LRU demand occurs, the forward-spare arm should use its local opening stock before any depot transport. Compare physical item identity, backorder, aircraft readiness, late missions and stock ledgers, including any shared-state effect.
The BASE-02 crew and mission are fully staffed in both arms; verify their identity and outcome, and do not assume their local stock or depot route is used.
acceptance_hypotheses: Two fresh serial guarded SSH0/mutex/GUI13340 native runs import/export/calculate/report, have zero conversion errors and no unreviewed diagnostics, roundtrip every populated authored table, and seal all raw evidence.

Only the BASE-01 opening LRU quantity is changed as a business field between arms. Any outcome claim requires matched failure/demand evidence; if no comparable demand occurs, classify as a no-effect boundary or run a separately contracted source variant.

Reconcile per-base aircraft and item identity, depot/local inventory movements, aggregate System/Stock/Resource half-hour bins, mission outcomes and terminal disposition. This does not establish other stock positions, route contention, repair capacity or larger network behavior.
